dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Presence of multiple interlocking 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-intensity (light) perimeters. The most prominent central-dorsal annulus exhibits a crenulated, irregular outer edge transitioning from the dark base background to a bright filamentary boundary; posterior annuli display more elongated, smooth-edged elliptical geometries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters localized primarily at the intersection points of the reticulated ring network in the anterior-lateral quadrant. Sparse, isolated bright pixel clusters are also visible along the ventral-lateral margin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-lateral annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. The angle formed at the central-most centroid is approximately 135 degrees, with the anterior-to-central distance being roughly 60% of the central-to-posterior distance.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, localized circular indentation or pit-like anomaly is visible in the upper-middle dorsal region, characterized by a lack of surface texture and a central core of low-intensity pixels relative to the surrounding patterned tissue.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive 'lace-like' reticulated pattern where high-contrast boundaries of adjacent annuli merge into a continuous geometric mesh covering approximately 80% of the visible dorsal-lateral surface.
